recipe.criteria: Static wall sit with both thighs horizontal, knees 90 degrees, feet flat and back supported. Arms extended in front. Eight seconds shows maintained hold; entry and exit omitted.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.

recipe.criteria: Static single-leg wall sit supported on left leg, thigh horizontal and knee 90 degrees. Right leg extended horizontally, back supported and arms extended forward. Eight seconds shows maintained hold; entry, exit and side change omitted.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
